citations: Pinned HA8TKS ITU75 original explicit rectangle spans longitudes -180 to 180 and latitudes 80 to 85 north; this independently authored interior is inside its unchanged Cartesian extent.
Pinned HA8TKS ITU74 original explicit rectangle spans longitudes -180 to 180 and latitudes 80 to 85 south; this independently authored interior is inside its unchanged Cartesian extent.
The original ITU75 rectangle's closed northern boundary is exactly 85N; no latitude beyond 85N is included by this interpretation.
The original ITU74 rectangle's closed southern boundary is exactly 85S; no latitude beyond 85S is included by this interpretation.
The selected original ITU75 band stops at 85N. No other original selected zone supplies coverage at this point; a polar cap must not be inferred.
The selected original ITU74 band stops at 85S. No other original selected zone supplies coverage at this point; a polar cap must not be inferred.

Locator AR spans 180W to 160W and 80N to 90N. The explicit ITU75 band covers only its 80N–85N portion; the 85N–90N part is uncovered. Neighboring original zones stop at 80N and add no positive-area candidate.

Locator RA spans 160E to 180E and 90S to 80S. The explicit ITU74 band covers only its 85S–80S portion; the 90S–85S part is uncovered. Neighboring original zones stop at 80S and add no positive-area candidate.
